concept.material: dark patinated copper with polished edges
concept.internal_detail: tightly wound brass mainsprings and minute interlocking lever arms
concept.button: a small raised copper rivet on the curved spine
concept.shell_mechanic: The crescent copper spine splits down its ventral groove and the two sides roll outward like opening shutters
concept.emerging_parts: A long flexible segmented vertebral chain and a tiny hinged jaw plate
concept.signature_move: its hinged jaw plate snaps open and shut with a crisp metal click, and its copper tail section whips once from side to side on its internal pivot
